system.description:
Skill: Medicine

Exploit Type: Combat Exploit

Requirements: Necrotic Hand Subclass

You are able to siphon off a portion of your target’s strength. When you deal Lethal Attack damage, you may choose to forgo 1 Lethal Attack damage dice. The target must make a Strength Saving throw.

On a failure, the target reduces its AC and Saving throws by 1, until the end of your next turn. You gain a +2 bonus to your next attack targeting the affected creature, until the end of your next turn.
